start: An online gym with an owner and two front desk people; the owner is signed in

steps.action: Open Staff & sign-in
user_sees: Title 'Staff & sign-in', under it 'Who can open this gym, on which phone'
Button 'Add a person'
Card 'You': name, pill 'Owner', '+91 …', the PIN line, 'Change my PIN' and 'Sign out of this device'
must_not: Another gym’s people
'Loading…' that never ends

steps.action: Read 'People who can sign in'
user_sees: 'To let someone in, or to use a new phone yourself, tap Make sign-in code. Then give them the code. It works once, for 30 minutes.'
Each row: name, a pill (Owner, Staff, Trainer or the typed job), 'You' on the own row, '+91 … · Signed in on 1 device · PIN set'
Buttons 'Make sign-in code', 'Sign out everywhere', 'Remove'
must_not: A 'Remove' button on the own row
A PIN or a code shown in a row
A removed person still listed

steps.action: Read the grey line at the bottom
user_sees: 'The owner can do everything. Staff (front desk) can add members, sell plans, collect fees, check members in, hand over shop orders and send members workout plans. Staff can give at most 10% off a plan, and must charge the joining fee as listed. Every receipt shows who took the money. Staff can date a payment at most 31 days back, never ahead. Staff cannot see money totals or expenses. They cannot cancel receipts, cancel or freeze plans, change plan prices or change gym details.'
must_not: A right named here that the panel does not keep

start: Other ways to the same page

steps.action: Settings: in the card 'Staff & sign-in' tap 'Staff & sign-in codes'
user_sees: The page Staff & sign-in
must_not: A blank page

steps.action: On a phone: More, row 'Staff & sign-in' with the hint 'Who can open this admin app, and your PIN'
user_sees: The same page
must_not: The row missing for an owner

steps.action: Today: the Get started step 'Add your staff and trainers'
user_sees: The same page
must_not: The step ticked just by opening the page

start: The page cannot show the list

steps.action: Open the page in a gym kept only in this browser
user_sees: 'Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data). Then you and your staff can sign in with a mobile number, on any phone or computer.'
Button 'Go to Settings'
must_not: An empty list with an Add button that fails

steps.action: Open the page online with the internet off
user_sees: An error box: 'Can’t reach the internet. Check the connection and try again.'
must_not: 'Loading…' for ever
An empty list shown as if nobody could sign in

steps.action: Open the page after the owner was signed out from another device
user_sees: The welcome screen with 'You were signed out of this gym. Ask the gym owner for a new code. If you are the owner, make one on a device where you are signed in.'
must_not: The old list still on screen

start: One front desk person moves through every state while the owner watches the row

steps.action: Add the person and look at the row
user_sees: 'Not signed in yet · No PIN yet'
must_not: 'Signed out' for someone who never signed in

steps.action: Make a code for them
user_sees: '· Code works till 5:40 pm' at the end of the row
must_not: The code itself in the row

steps.action: They sign in and set a PIN; open the page again
user_sees: 'Signed in on 1 device · PIN set'; the code words are gone
must_not: The row unchanged until the browser is reloaded by hand with no hint

steps.action: They type a wrong PIN too often on another phone; open the page again
user_sees: '· PIN locked till <time> (too many wrong tries)'
must_not: A lock time in the past still shown

steps.action: Sign them out everywhere; open the page
user_sees: 'Signed out · No PIN yet'
must_not: 'Signed in on 0 devices'

start: Who sees what on this page

steps.action: As owner read every row
user_sees: Names, mobile numbers, device counts, whether a PIN is set
must_not: Any PIN
Any code made earlier
Which phone model or place a person signed in from

steps.action: With branches: open the page in branch B
user_sees: Owners plus only branch B’s staff
The bottom line starts 'Owners are owners of every branch. Staff work only at the branch they are added to.'

start: A front desk person looks for what only an owner may do

steps.action: Look for a way to add a person, make a code or see the others
user_sees: Only the 'You' card and 'Only an owner can add people or make sign-in codes. Ask your gym owner.'
must_not: The people list asked from the server for a staff sign-in
Any owner button

start: The front desk person’s own PIN changes state

steps.action: Open the page with no PIN set
user_sees: 'You have no PIN yet. Set one, and you can sign in any time with your mobile number and your PIN.'
Button 'Set my PIN'
must_not: 'Change my PIN' when none is set

steps.action: Set a PIN
user_sees: Toast 'PIN saved. Sign in with your mobile number and this PIN.'
'You sign in with your mobile number and your own PIN (set on 19 Nov 2026).'
Button 'Change my PIN'
must_not: The old words until a reload

steps.action: Lock the PIN with wrong tries on another phone, open the page here
user_sees: 'Your PIN is locked till <time> after too many wrong tries. You can still sign in with a code from the owner.'
must_not: No word about the lock

steps.action: The owner removes this person while the page is open; do anything
user_sees: The welcome screen with 'You no longer have access to this gym. Talk to the gym owner.'
must_not: The page staying open and usable
